:::{#sol-miller-deriv-tangent-line-approx-tangent}

Evaluate $f$ and $f'$ at $x_0 = \pi/4$:

$$\ba
f(\pi/4) &= 4\paren{\frac{\pi}{4}} + \sqrt{2}\cosf{\frac{\pi}{4}} \\
&= \pi + \sqrt{2}\paren{\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}} \\
&= \pi + 1
\\
f'(\pi/4) &= 4 - \sqrt{2}\sinf{\frac{\pi}{4}} \\
&= 4 - \sqrt{2}\paren{\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}} \\
&= 4 - 1 \\
&= 3
\ea$$

Using the point-slope formula, the tangent line at $(\pi/4, \pi + 1)$ is:

$$y - (\pi + 1) = 3\paren{x - \frac{\pi}{4}} \implies y = \pi + 1 + 3\paren{x - \frac{\pi}{4}}$$

:::
